description: Pure lookup extracted from run_pipeline so the terminal_status_mapping table (06_orchestration.module_spec.json) is exercised as its own testable unit rather than only indirectly through nine separate raise-and-inspect integration-style tests inline in run_pipeline's own tests.
signature: def _map_exception_to_terminal_status(exc: BaseException, stage: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]
docstring:
Map a raised exception to (run_status, stage_status, error_message).

Args:
    exc: The exception caught by run_pipeline's handler.
    stage: The PipelineStage.value the exception occurred in, or RUN_LEVEL_STAGE if it occurred during preflight (before any stage began).

Returns:
    (run_status, stage_status, error_message) exactly per the terminal_status_mapping table: PipelineCancelled -> ('cancelled', 'cancelled', 'cancelled by user during {stage}'); KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit -> ('cancelled', 'cancelled', 'interrupted during {stage}'); PreflightError -> ('failed', <no stage row, caller does not call finish_run_stage for this case>, the wrapped validation message); RequestBudgetExceeded -> ('failed', 'failed', budget/requests-made message); AcquisitionError/EnrichmentError/AnalysisError/StorageError/any other Exception -> ('failed', 'failed', '{stage}: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}').

Does not raise. Does not write anything -- purely a lookup so run_pipeline's own exception handler stays a thin caller of this plus the actual storage writes.
preconditions: stage is a PipelineStage.value or RUN_LEVEL_STAGE
postconditions: For PreflightError, the returned stage_status is a sentinel meaning 'do not call finish_run_stage' (e.g. None), since no run_stages row exists yet for a preflight failure

error_message never exceeds the column's sane length cap; anything longer is truncated with an explicit marker, and the full text still reaches run_events separately as run_pipeline's own responsibility, not this function's

edge_cases.input: exc is a bare KeyboardInterrupt (no stage-specific payload)
exc is PreflightError wrapping a ParameterError
edge_cases.expected_behavior: ('failed', None, the PreflightError's own message) -- run_pipeline must not call finish_run_stage when this sentinel is returned

edge_cases.input: exc is a plain ValueError not matching any named category
edge_cases.expected_behavior: falls through to the 'any other Exception' row: ('failed', 'failed', f'{stage}: ValueError: {exc}')

edge_cases.input: str(exc) contains a very long traceback-like multi-line message
edge_cases.expected_behavior: error_message is a single truncated line; the caller is responsible for logging the full text as a separate run_event, not this function

unit_tests.name: test_pipelinecancelled_mapping
unit_tests.description: PipelineCancelled maps to the cancelled/cancelled row with the stage named in the message.

unit_tests.name: test_preflighterror_mapping_has_no_stage_row
unit_tests.description: PreflightError's stage_status is the no-stage-row sentinel.

unit_tests.name: test_generic_exception_mapping
unit_tests.description: An unrecognized exception type produces the fixed '{stage}: {Type}: {message}' format.

unit_tests.name: test_all_nine_terminal_status_mapping_rows_covered
unit_tests.description: Table-driven test asserts every row of 06_orchestration.module_spec.json's terminal_status_mapping is reproduced exactly by this function.
